youtube_shorts.architecture: Pull system -> Two-Tower Candidate Generation (co-watching) -> MMoE Multitask Ranking (Engagement vs Viewer Satisfaction Surveys)
key_levers: Frame-0 instant action (zero dead air or greeting)
Seamless loop cut right on climax resolution (prevents 20-25% final-second drop)
Shorts Search SEO: front-loaded title <=55 chars + spoken ASR keywords + 3-5 hashtags

monetization_compliance.reused_content_rule: YPP human review evaluates entire channel; raw streamer clips with only captions/TTS fail Reused/Inauthentic Content even with creator permission.

instagram_reels.architecture: Meta AI Staged Distribution + Andromeda Deep Semantic Retrieval + UTIS Satisfaction Surveys + Originality Score
key_levers: DM-shareable hook and CTA ('Send this to your duo...')
Trial Reels native 72h cold-audience A/B testing for distinct 0-3s hook variants
penalties: Reposting identical MP4 repeatedly in Trial Reels

tiktok.architecture: ByteDance Monolith (Cuckoo HashMap collisionless embedding tables + Kafka/Flink real-time streaming updates + MMoE fine-ranking)
key_levers: Triple-indexed TikTok Search SEO: spoken ASR + on-screen OCR text + caption
Safe A/B recycling: transform 0-3s hook, on-screen banner, and re-encode hash before reposting failed variant
Strict 0-7.5s profanity bleeper + OCR text masking to prevent automated FYF suppression

cover_spec.organic_api_param: post_info.video_cover_timestamp_ms (no external JPG upload in organic Content Posting API)

facebook_reels.architecture: Meta AI Unified Video Ranking + Facebook Content Monetization Program + Strict Originality Guidelines
key_levers: Custom 1080x1920 cover uploaded via Meta Business Suite
Strict adherence to top 14% / bottom 35% / sides 6% UI margins
penalties: Engagement bait and spammy keyword-stuffed captions

cover_spec.upload_surface: Meta Business Suite -> Cover -> Upload Image

x_twitter.architecture: xai-org/x-algorithm: SimClusters (~145k communities) + TwHIN Graph Embeddings + Phoenix Rust/Python Transformer Heavy Ranker
key_levers: Native MP4 upload targeting >=50% and 100% video watch-through + dwell time
Zero external links in main post (use link-in-reply to promote YouTube Long-Form)
Organic author reply to early real comments (triggers ~75x / 150x-like multiplier; zero bots)
penalties: Toxic rage bait causing Reports, Blocks, Mutes, or Show Less Often

creator_frameworks.paddy_galloway_ccn: Satisfy Core (lore/callbacks), Casual (quick re-onboarding), and New (zero-context instant visual hook) simultaneously; <=3 thumbnail elements; complementary title + visual curiosity gap.
creator_frameworks.jenny_hoyos_shorts: Frame-1 visual shock -> <3s clear stakes/foreshadowing -> cut cleanly on climax resolution (avoid 20-25% final-second cliff) -> 5th-grade reading ease.
creator_frameworks.kallaway_triple_hook: Strict alignment of Visual Hook (mute-understandable) + Audio Hook (context lean) + Text Hook (disruptive pattern interrupt).
creator_frameworks.brendan_kane_hook_point: Hyper-specific or counter-intuitive 3-second hook; iterate structural viral templates.
creator_frameworks.derral_eves_youtube_formula: Algorithm tracks viewer behavior (CTR x Retention); iterate systematically on retention drop-off timestamps.
creator_frameworks.mrbeast_production_memo: Obsess over opening hook and minutes 1-3 in Long-Form; keep structure radically simple inside high-stakes action.

strict_ban_red_lines: NEVER use secondary sock-puppet accounts, Playwright comment bots, or anti-detect browsers (Multilogin/Dolphin Anty)
NEVER repost identical failed MP4s without transforming 0-3s hook and visual hash
NEVER mix raw Bounties CPM clips (voice_mode=none) onto an Owned YPP AdSense channel without human commentary transformation
